correctness.rationale: The Petersen graph has a stated finite 15-edge model. Canonical restricted-growth enumeration and independent fixed-star enumeration each produce exactly 2080 four-edge-colour classes and agree as sets; all use 4 colours. Two independently traversed two-colour component routines agree on all 2080 neighbour sets; symmetry, degree sums and BFS distances fully checked with exact integers. The verifier also enumerates all 120 vertex automorphisms and confirms the complete weighted 21-orbit eccentricity profile. Only this quotient construction is claimed.

value.rationale: The Petersen graph is the smallest cubic class-II graph, hence the canonical first example requiring a fourth edge colour and testing quantitative Kempe reconfiguration. Exact diameter/radius and eccentricity-symmetry strata provide a complete, motivated reconfiguration benchmark beyond the known connectivity theorem. The centre is a single automorphism orbit, while the diameter-eccentric states split into inequivalent orbits; this discriminates the geometry of Kempe steps rather than recording an arbitrary isolated count.
